stem_book: Find the distance travelled by the block if μ_K = V₀t/2 and initial velocity of block is V₀? (a) infinite (b) 4V₀/(3√g) (c) V₀²/g (d) 2V₀/g
reason: μ_K = V₀t/2 is dimensionally loose but taken numerically as printed gives option (b)
work: a = −μg = −gV₀t/2 → v = V₀(1 − gt²/4) = 0 at t = 2/√g; s = V₀t − gV₀t³/12 = 2V₀/√g − (2/3)V₀/√g = 4V₀/(3√g)
